question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is '**measure**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses the limitations of using BMI as a tool and suggests that it should not be the sole factor in determining healthy weight.
 
• The word should reflect the concept of a criterion or tool used for assessment.
 
• '**Measure**' fits well as it means a tool or standard used for comparison, aligning with the context of BMI.
 
• Other options ("**wobble**", "**serendipity**", "**evanesce**") do not fit the context of being an assessment criterion.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

Complete Passage: *We’re a society fixated on numbers. So, it’s no (1).* *surprise__* *we use measurements and equations to score our weight. The most (2).* *__popular__* *is BMI, a measure of our body weight to height ratio. BMI (3).* *__classifies__* *bodies as underweight, normal or healthy weight, overweight or obese and can be a useful tool for weight and health (4).* *__screening__* *. But it shouldn’t be used as the single (5).* *__measure__* *of what it means to be a healthy weight when we set our weight loss goals.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Wobble (डगमगाना): "Wobble" means to move unsteadily, which does not fit the context of an assessment criterion.
 
• Serendipity (सौभाग्य): "Serendipity" means finding something good without looking for it, which does not fit the context of an assessment criterion.
 
• Evanesce (शाश्वत): "Evanesce" means to disappear gradually, which does not fit the context of an assessment criterion.
